comments.author: @BorderlineWonders
comments.text: Did we miss anything about the Cascadia or Pacific Northwest? What shocked you the most? Comment below 🙃

comments.author: @HotspotAtlas-z8m
comments.text: I never realized how much of the Pacific Northwest's identity comes from geology rather than the borders we see on maps. The story of the 1700 Cascadia earthquake and the Japanese tsunami connection was especially fascinating. It's crazy to think that the same geological forces shaped both sides of the Pacific and are still influencing the region today. Makes you look at the Washington–Canada border completely differently!
